paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
suggested_experiment_name: MOJAVE VLBA AGN jet polarization (ULDM ALP)
notes: Constraint on ALP-photon coupling from polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in AGN (MOJAVE VLBA).
